svg.text: Legislation: ELI 1.4 and Akoma Ntoso 1.0 ontology

14 nodes · 7 relationships · 1 implied labels, generated from crosswalk.json, from the model.json of ELI 1.4, Akoma Ntoso 1.0. The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the term in its standard.
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: SAME_AS: eli:LegalResource skos:closeMatch akn:FRBRWork. Both are the abstract act, the FRBR work, whatever its versions and languages. ELI's legal resource is the act itself, holding its metadata; Akoma Ntoso's FRBR work is the work level of a document's identification block, and an Akoma Ntoso document carries one for its own act. The act's number is the same in both, and the Akoma Ntoso work-level FRBR URI is the act's local identifier in ELI. Linked nodes share number and frbrNumber, id_local and frbrUri.

SAME_AS: eli:LegalExpression skos:closeMatch akn:FRBRExpression. Both are a version of the act in one language, the FRBR expression: an original, amended or consolidated text. ELI gives an expression its title and publication dates; Akoma Ntoso its version number, languages and whether it is authoritative. The expression-level FRBR URI is the expression's local identifier in ELI. Linked nodes share id_local and frbrUri.

SAME_AS: eli:Format skos:closeMatch akn:FRBRManifestation. Both are an embodiment of an expression in a format, the FRBR manifestation, e.g. the Akoma Ntoso XML or a PDF. The manifestation-level FRBR URI is the format's local identifier in ELI. Linked nodes share id_local and frbrUri.

SAME_AS: eli:LegalResourceSubdivision skos:closeMatch akn:Hierarchy. Both are a part of an act at any level, from a chapter to an article or a paragraph. ELI identifies a subdivision as a legal resource of its own, part of the act; Akoma Ntoso marks it up as a hierarchical element of the act's body, with its number and heading. Their numbers are written differently, e.g. 5 and 5., so the crosswalk doesn't compare them.

SAME_AS: eli:Organization skos:closeMatch akn:TLCOrganization. An organization that passes, publishes or holds the rights to an act. ELI identifies the organization by its IRI; an Akoma Ntoso TLC reference stands for it within one document, pointing at the same IRI by its href, and the document's text and metadata refer to it through the reference. Linked nodes share uri and href.
SAME_AS: eli:Person skos:closeMatch akn:TLCPerson. A person involved in an act, identified by an IRI in ELI and by a TLC reference pointing at it in Akoma Ntoso. Linked nodes share uri and href.

SAME_AS: eli:Concept skos:closeMatch akn:TLCConcept. A subject an act is about, from a thesaurus or authority table: an ELI work is about a SKOS concept, an Akoma Ntoso term in the text refers to a TLC concept pointing at the same IRI. ELI's concept also stands for authority-table values, such as languages or resource types, which Akoma Ntoso holds as attribute values rather than references. Linked nodes share uri and href.
Every eli__LegalResourceSubdivision is also a eli__LegalResource

g.title: eli__LegalExpression — The intellectual realisation of a legal resource in the form of a "sequence of signs" (typically alpha-numeric characters in a legal context). For example, any version of the legal resource whose content is specified and different from others for any reason: language, versions, etc.; Note that ELI ontology accommodates different point of view on what should be considered a new legal resource, or a new legal expression of the same resource. Typically, a consolidated version can be viewed, in the context of ELI, either as separate legal resource (linked to original version and previous consolidated version using corresponding ELI relations), or as a different legal expression of the same legal resource. Properties: uri, cites, cited_by_case_law, related_to, uri_schema, cited_by_case_law_reference, date_applicability, date_no_longer_in_force, date_publication, description, first_date_entry_in_force, id_local, number, publisher, version_date, title, title_alternative, title_short

eli__LegalResource — A work in a legislative corpus. This applies to acts that have been legally enacted (whether or not they are still in force). For example, the abstract concept of the legal resource; e.g. "act 3 of 2005" (adapted from Akoma Ntoso) A legal resource can represent a legal act or any component of a legal act, like an article. Legal resources can be linked together using properties defined in the model. Note that ELI ontology accommodates different point of view on what should be considered a new legal resource, or a new legal expression of the same resource. Typically, a consolidated version can be viewed, in the context of ELI, either as separate legal resource (linked to original version and previous consolidated version using corresponding ELI relations), or as a different legal expression of the same legal resource. Properties: uri, cites, cited_by_case_law, related_to, uri_schema, cited_by_case_law_reference, date_applicability, date_no_longer_in_force, date_publication, description, first_date_entry_in_force, id_local, number, responsibility_of, version_date, date_document

eli__Format — The physical embodiment of a legal expression, either on paper or in any electronic format. For example, any electronic or physical format of the legal expression (XML, TIFF, PDF, etc.) ; e.g. PDF version of act 3 of 2005. (adapted from Akoma Ntoso). Note that the notion of Format in ELI is more precise than a FRBR Manifestation in the sense that a Format in ELI can carry a legal value (see the property eli:legal_value). Properties: uri, licence, uri_schema, id_local, published_in, publisher, rights, rightsholder, is_exemplified_by, media_type

eli__LegalResourceSubdivision — A component of a legal act, at an arbitrary level of precision, like a chapter, an article, an alinea, a paragraph or an list item. A subdivision can be linked with its parent and children subdivision using the properties eli:has_part / eli:is_part_of. Properties: uri, date_document
eli__Organization — Institutions or groups of people that have obtained a legal recognition as a group and can act collectively as agents. Properties: uri
eli__Person — A real person who live or has lived. Properties: uri

eli__Concept — An idea or notion; a unit of thought, from a concept scheme such as an authority table or a thesaurus (SKOS). ELI's concept classes, e.g. InForce or ResourceType, are concepts of their scheme, and eli:is_about takes concepts from any scheme, e.g. EuroVoc. Properties: uri, prefLabel

akn__FRBRExpression — The element FRBRExpression is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Expression level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri, frbrVersionNumber, frbrAuthoritative, frbrMasterExpression, frbrLanguage, frbrThis, frbrUri, frbrAlias, frbrAliasName, frbrDate, frbrDateName

akn__FRBRManifestation — The element FRBRManifestation is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Manifestation level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri, frbrFormat, frbrThis, frbrUri, frbrAlias, frbrAliasName, frbrDate, frbrDateName

akn__FRBRWork — The element FRBRWork is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Work level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri, frbrCountry, frbrSubtype, frbrNumber, frbrName, frbrPrescriptive, frbrAuthoritative, frbrThis, frbrUri, frbrAlias, frbrAliasName, frbrDate, frbrDateName

akn__Hierarchy — The group hierElements lists all the elements that are hierarchical. A label carried by Alinea, Article, Book, Chapter, Clause, Division, Hcontainer, Indent, Level, List, Paragraph, Part, Point, Proviso, Rule, Section, Subchapter, Subclause, Subdivision, Sublist, Subparagraph, Subpart, Subrule, Subsection, Subtitle, Title, Tome and Transitional. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading, period, status, eId, wId, guid, refersTo, lang, alternativeTo
akn__TLCConcept — The element TLCConcept is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Concept. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, showAs, shortForm

akn__TLCOrganization — The element TLCOrganization is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Organization. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, showAs, shortForm
akn__TLCPerson — The element TLCPerson is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Person. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, showAs, shortForm
